body:
blocked: waiting on unimplemented `#1773` sub-issues (`#1942`, `#1944`, `#1945`, `#1946`, `#1947`).

Checked `upstream/main` at `17a8c6e76` and all open PRs in `NeoTech/Camcraft`:

- Only `#1943` (PR #2028: offline MCP schema mapper and prompt-JSON parser in `crates/app/src/mcp/provider.rs`, `provider_calls.rs`, `fallback.rs`, `schema_validation.rs`) has merged.
- None of the user-facing features `#1949` must document exist on `upstream/main` or in any open PR yet:
  - `#1942` (open, no PR): `BatchCommand` turn undo (`begin_group`/`commit_group`) in `crates/app/src/commands/mod.rs`, `get_selection` MCP tool, and the live confirmation gate in `crates/app/src/mcp/live.rs` (needed for Tasks 2, 3, and 4).
  - `#1944` (open, no PR): compact read modes (`summary` on `get_job`, filters on `list_operation_types`, compact `list_features`), core tool subset, and context-window budgets (needed for small-context setup and troubleshooting).
  - `#1945` (open, no PR): AI provider HTTP clients, OS keychain (`keyring`) / env-var key storage, and `ai_offline_only` in `crates/app/src/prefs.rs` (needed for provider setup, API key storage, privacy, and key/connection troubleshooting).
  - `#1946` (open, no PR): in-app `Tab::AiChat` dock panel in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs`, UI controls, tool cards, Undo Turn button, fallback Q&A banner, and inline Allow/Deny prompts (needed for in-app panel setup and Tasks 1-4).
  - `#1947` (open, no PR): Codex CLI (`AGENTS.md` / `.codex/`), Gemini and Antigravity CLI (`GEMINI.md` / `.agents/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`), embedded local-model prompt, and `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md` updates.

Per CamCraft's guide policy (`docs/decisions/1939-guide-review.md`, `site/content/guide/reference/troubleshooting.md`), user guide pages must only document shipped UI controls, flags, MCP tools, and real error messages. Writing `ai.md` before those five issues land would either omit most of the required scope or invent unimplemented UI labels and messages.

Notes for whoever unblocks `#1949` after `#1942`, `#1944`, `#1945`, `#1946`, and `#1947` merge:
- `site/content/guide/mcp.md` was moved to `site/content/guide/automate/mcp.md` (with `aliases = ["guide/mcp/"]`) in PR #1908.
- `site/templates/guide-nav.html` and `site/tests/test_guide_navigation.py` organize user guide pages inside section directories (for example `site/content/guide/automate/ai.md` with `aliases = ["guide/ai/"]`).

Stopped before claiming (`#1949` left open, not claimed, no branch/worktree/PR created).
